candidates.description: Vacuum flasks and other vacuum vessels, complete; parts thereof other than glass inners: Having a capacity not exceeding 1 liter

what_would_settle_it: Whether the article's essential character is the stainless-steel kitchen/tableware material (heading 7323, e.g. N299732 and N297165 classified stainless insulated water bottles under 7323.93.0080) or the vacuum-insulation function (heading 9617, under which CBP classified vacuum insulated stainless bottles in N321985). Within heading 7323, the importer must also pick a statistical suffix — "Kitchen ware" (7323.93.0060) versus catch-all "Other" (7323.93.0080). Within heading 9617, capacity is the further break (1 L, 1–2 L, >2 L, or "Parts" if importing components only). The dividing case-law question is whether the vacuum space between two walls of stainless steel is the essential character — a CROSS ruling search for the same product description and any preclassification ruling on the importer's exact article is the controlling input the importer still owes.
